description: Map field values based on conditional comparisons. Supports multiple fields and various comparison operators.

mapping_rules.info: Configure multiple field value mapping rules. Each rule compares a field value against a condition and outputs a replacement value when matched.

input_field_desc: The field name to read the value from for comparison
operator_desc: Comparison operator to use (=, !=, >, <, contains, etc.)
compare_value_desc: The value to compare against the input field value
replacement_value_desc: The value to output when the condition matches
output_field_desc: The field name to write the replacement value to (can be same as input field to overwrite)

status.analysis_success: Field analysis completed, generated {count} mapping templates
status.no_fields_found: No fields found in upstream data

errors.missing_fields: Input field and output field are required for each rule
errors.no_data_input: No data input available for field analysis
errors.no_fields_found: No fields found in the data
errors.no_graph_data: No graph data available for field analysis
errors.graph_not_available: Graph context not available for field analysis

warnings.field_not_found: Input field '{field}' not found in data
warnings.no_match: No mapping rule matched for field '{field}' value '{value}'
